title: Integrated Development Environment (IDE) — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. The key distinction this database honors: a description of a integrated Development Environment (IDE) is not itself a integrated Development Environment (IDE). So this record carries the ACTUAL working implementation — real code, executed at build time, with verified outputs recorded below.
